The '''Council Rules of Order''' were a set of laws pertaining to the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Council Rules of Order were mentioned in the [[July]] [[1998]] young-readers story ''[[Star Wars Journal: Captive to Evil]]'', written by [[Jude Watson]].
